blocks.text: Why not embrace the transformative power of Seamoss, the ultimate natural superfood. This incredible gift from nature is a one-stop solution for comprehensive wellness, nourishing your entire body inside and out.

By incorporating Sea Moss into your daily routine, you can unlock a world of benefits that will leave you feeling revitalized and refreshed. Seamoss supercharges your immune system, helps heal ailments such as ulcers and fibroids, and supports gut health, thyroid function, and weight management.

We pride ourselves on all our products and we do not compromise on quality. We partner with leading suppliers of natural, organic and essential oils across the globe. Our supplier sources from over 130 farmers throughout Africa and surrounding islands. Our seamoss is harvested naturally. We strategically partner to source breakthroughs ingredients. We nurture our supplier relationships to stay up to date with groundbreaking trends.

This is one of the most potent red algaes in the world, it contains powerful healing energy and has many benefits for your skin, hair, gut health and more. This Red Algae is harvested and gathered from the Indian Ocean, by the indigenous women of Tanzania. Wildcrafted Sea Moss is a tasteless mineral-rich sea vegetable that contains up to 99 of the 102 organic minerals that makes up the human body. Eat it everyday and as much as your body needs (Red Algae- water soluble minerals).
Follow these instructions to prepare Raw Seamoss

1. Rinse and Soak: Rinse the raw sea moss in cold filtered or spring water.
2. Soak it in water or a plant-based milk for 4-8 hours or overnight.
3. Blend the soaked sea moss with your preferred liquid (water, milk, or smoothie) in a 1:1 ratio.
4. Strain the mixture through a cheese cloth or a nut milk bag to remove any gel-like texture.
5. Consume the raw sea moss gel directly or add it to your favorite recipes.
6. Dosage: Start with a small dose (1-2 tablespoons) and gradually increase as needed.
HOW TO MAKE THE SEAMOSS GEL
Add to blender ratio: (2:1 ratio) 2 parts cleaned and soaked sea moss and 1 part water.
Blend until smooth pudding texture (blend for 30 seconds to 2 minutes long).

Some popular ways to use raw seamoss include:


a) Adding it to smoothies or juices.

b) Using it as a thickening agent in recipes.

c) Making a face mask or skin gel.

d) Adding it to soups or stews.

e) Using it as a vegan substitute for gelatin.)
If you have a medical condition consult a doctor before using this health product.
